title: Interaction
description: A structural (doctrinal), not mission-instance-specific, edge in the mission execution interaction network: who or what interacts with who or what, and how. Sits alongside DoctrineProcess as a description of how the enterprise normally operates, at a finer grain — individual personnel and the systems they use, rather than organizational tasking flow. See ARCHITECTURE.md Section 6.

commsLink.description: For a CommunicatesVia, Informs, or AuthenticatesTo interaction: whether this specific hop is verbal or digital, its medium, and — if digital — its protocol and message format. Omitted for interaction types that describe an organizational/operational relationship rather than a literal communications hop (Operates, CoordinatesWith, Commands, Deploys).

viaSystem.description: When this interaction's information flow is physically relayed through a System not already named as 'from' or 'to' (e.g. a role-to-role Informs relayed over an intercom or radio net), the System (kind: 'system') that carries it.
